_doc: Single control file for the AlphaZero Xiangqi agent. Keys starting with _ are documentation and are stripped on load. Override with XIANGQI_CONFIG or load_config(path).

paths._doc: Relative to the process working directory.

encode._doc: Input tensor is float32 CHW (C, 10, 9). C = history_length * (7*our + 7*opp) + extras. perspective_current_player rotates the board 180° when Black to move so the side to act always sits on rank 0; value v is that side's expected outcome in [-1, 1].

action._doc: from_to: index = from_sq * 90 + to_sq in network coordinates (already flipped if Black to move). Illegal slots are masked before softmax. size must stay 8100 for this encoding.

network._doc: AlphaZero dual-head residual tower. Policy logits have size action.size. Value is tanh in [-1, 1] for the current player.

mcts._doc: PUCT: Q + c_puct * P * sqrt(N) / (1+n). If c_puct_base>0, c_puct grows like the AlphaZero appendix. Dirichlet noise is added at the root during self-play (add_dirichlet_noise). Evaluation games should pass add_noise=False.

selfplay._doc: One iteration generates n_games_per_iter games, each on its own Board.

train._doc: Loss = policy_loss_weight * CE(π, p) + value_loss_weight * (z - v)^2 + weight_decay. Paper used SGD; adam is the default here because it is stabler at small batch size.

play._doc: Local visualization UI only (python -m xiangqi_engine.play). Does not affect self-play, training, or MCTS defaults used by the loop.

rules._doc: Must stay in sync with the C++ engine. repetition_draw_count 3 and no_progress_halfmoves 120 are the current simplified draw rules.
